notes.title: A peek at the upcoming Update + Autumn Sale!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Thank you for your continued support of Let Them Trade! We're so very happy to see you having fun with the game and getting your feedback here and on our discord <3



The team is back in their groove and working tirelessly to bring you a new update soon - so today we wanted to share a little snippet of what you can expect when it drops!



New resources and research tree changes!

We are reworking the research tree and the production chains. New resources got added to make the middle to late game more interesting. Accompaning that are new buildings and icons for the new resources.



Visual variety!

We're introducing tile variations for some tile types, like different forests.



New Bounty System!

Cities will place a bounty on the bandits who stole their goods. Players will be able to collect the bounty after capturing the bandit.

Also a lot of smaller improvements in regards to the bandits.



Smarter Transporters!

Inner-city transporters will be able to work more efficiently. They are able to transport multiple resources and do multiple tasks at once. They try to combine different routes for different resources and to avoid travelling empty when there is something on their way they can pick up. They also prioritize the resources they need to transport differently. And loading/unloading times are now influenced by how much they carry. (that was a fixed time till now) The UI now reflects how much a transporter is transporting.



Performance optimisations!

Reworking our rendering to be much more stable and produce less visual artifacts. Lower-end systems should get more frames now and everyone should experience less crashes.



Balancing!

Rebalanced the economy

Added new modifications

Increased input and output capacities



Quality-of-life changes!

Redid the general resource overview in the top left to be much clearer

Quickly access "donate" and "collect" buttons by pressing and holding the "Shift" key

Lots of smaller bug fixes and tweaks



We'll post a more detailed changelog once the update is out!

Until then, owners of Let Them Trade can hop on the Discord to try out some of the new changes now!



One more thing - Let Them Trade will participate in Steam Autumn Sale next week, so if you're looking to get the game with a nice discount now's your chance!



See you soon and happy trading!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Old Save Games
Trader and transporter counts updated to match new game constants.

Outdated buildings rebuilt using base stats, upgrades, modifications, synergy, and global effects.

Outdated research effects removed; current research bonuses applied (e.g., unit speed, capacity).
[hr][/hr]Changes
Moved road/bridge deconstruction to a new build menu item.

Added global building count to build tooltips.

Hovering over a build item now highlights all buildings of that type.

Achievements now unlockable in custom maps.

Guard flags can be set on bridges.

Battles no longer occur on bridges; nearest bridgehead is used instead.

Added shortcut T for research tree.

Added shortcut Tab to select knights.
[hr][/hr]Bugfixes
Single-slot residential buildings now start with “Content” happiness to prevent early departure.

Global stock info now updates correctly when a city is deconstructed.

Cities can no longer share duplicate names.

Fixed scouting sometimes revealing the entire map too early.

Fixed certain modifications reducing instead of boosting production.

Fixed some research effects not applying.

Fixed quests occasionally not starting.

Fixed possible crash during city destruction.

Battle zones now clean up correctly when a trader’s city is deconstructed.

Fixed final quest not spawning in some games.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Tweaks
Added prebuilt research lab to branching out

Small changes to quest timing in branching out to prevent simultaneous king messages

Removed visible fish tile on other side of bay from starting area in fishy business

Small change to scouting north quest condition in fishy business to prevent players from soft-locking themselves

Added more transporters to city upgrades

Upgrade 1: +1 → +1

Upgrade 2: +1 → +2

Upgrade 3: +1 → +2

Upgrade 4: +1 → +3

Start speed of city transporters +10%

Transporter numbers and stats will be updated on load if save game version is outdated.

We will rework the city transporters in the future but for the time being simply giving the player more slightly faster transporters should mitigate bottle necks in the city logistic.

notes.title: News: We have a release date!
notes.notes:
Release Date

Yes, finally! We have a release date for Let Them Trade. The long wait will be over on the:

24th of July, 2025 

This is when Let Them Trade will release fully. It only took us 6 years to get to this point, but here it is. 

If you played the demo you can expect a lot of new & exciting stuff in the full release, like: 

The higher tiers of the research tree with new resources and production chains, 
A campaign mode with varied scenarios for you to play 
Bandits and the possibility to shush them away with your knight and their entourage 
A map editor and the option to share your maps with the community via the Steam workshop.


Steam Next Fest

Thank you all for the amazing response to our demo so far! We are really glad you enjoy what we showed you so far.

If you like our demo, make sure you don't miss our Steam Next Fest update! This update will bring you a first look into our bandit system and bring a new use to the knights. We are really excited for your feedback on that! The update will go live on June 9th, in time with the Steam Next Fest. It will be served as an update to the regular demo.

In the meantime, if you want to stay updated and chat with our community, please join our Discord! :)

Sincerely,
Spaceflower
